text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...It really is difficult after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I really thought I could win today.
That's how hard I felt I worked for it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still, both my training... and my race performance...
were nowhere near good enough.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I still have a long way to go.
......

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I still have a long way to go.
......

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. I... want to embody it. To prove that those words are the ultimate truth.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I truly believe.
She had undeniably put in the effort—steadier and more diligently than anyone else.

Until the day her efforts are rewarded,
what I can do is—
"It may simply be a matter of continuously giving her water so that her heart does not wither away."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-sa―

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
My, do you intend to leave me completely speechless?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If you insist that much...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'll try believing in everything I've done so far once more, too.
I'm going to give it one more shot.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I will do my best once again starting tomorrow.
I look forward to your continued
guidance and support."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...It's all about... keeping at it, step by step.
Solidly... and steadily.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is my strength.
Inherited from my mother... my weapon.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Somehow... it feels as though my vision has cleared up.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: If my mother had seen me... she might have laughed and said, "That's not like you."
